FROM node:20-bookworm-slim AS frontend-build

WORKDIR /build/ui
COPY ui/package.json ui/package-lock.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci
COPY ui/ ./
# Browser-visible API URL only. Do not pass LLM credentials as build args.
ARG VITE_F2W_AGENT_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8090
ENV VITE_F2W_AGENT_API_URL=${VITE_F2W_AGENT_API_URL}
RUN npm run build


FROM nginx:1.27-alpine AS frontend

COPY docker/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY --from=frontend-build /build/ui/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

FROM python:3.12-slim AS agent

# Runtime secrets are injected by Compose env_file from the host dotenv file.
# Do not pass LLM credentials as build args or bake dotenv files into layers.

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PYSTOW_HOME=/app/.cache/pystow \
    SPLASH_LINKS_REPO=/app/splash_links \
    F2W_AGENT_HOST=0.0.0.0 \
    F2W_AGENT_PORT=8090 \
    KG_RAG_FORCE_CPU=1

COPY requirements.txt ./
COPY requirements/runtime.txt ./requirements/runtime.txt
COPY requirements/semantic.in ./requirements/semantic.in
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
    python -m pip install --upgrade pip && \
    python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

COPY splash_links ./splash_links
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/rattler \
    pixi install --manifest-path splash_links/pixi.toml --locked

COPY . .

RUN mkdir -p /app/.cache/pystow /app/runs && \
    chmod +x scripts/start_agent_backend.sh

HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=5s --start-period=45s --retries=12 \
    CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8090/health >/dev/null || exit 1

CMD ["./scripts/start_agent_backend.sh"]

name: project template

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

- name: Test with pytest
      run: pytest
    - name: Build MkDocs site strictly
      run: mkdocs build --strict -f mkdocs/mkdocs.yml
    - name: Build MkDocs site
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force -f mkdocs/mkdocs.yml
    - name: Update Readme Tree
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: python scripts/update_readme_tree.py

on:
  push:
    branches: [ 'main' ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  build-and-push-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

# ── Extract process note ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# scripts/run.py (paper extraction) is NOT managed here. Start it separately
# so it survives agent/UI restarts and terminal/session closure:
#
#   nohup python scripts/run.py ...  &       # background in current shell
#   tmux new-session -d -s extract 'python scripts/run.py ...'
#
# `docker compose down` stops agent+UI only; extraction is unaffected.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Ports (loopback only):
#   UI    127.0.0.1:5175  (never 5174 — that port is SSH)
#   Agent 127.0.0.1:8090  (browser uses VITE_F2W_AGENT_API_URL)
#
# Darwin / Docker Desktop: IPv6 egress to api.cborg.lbl.gov is unreliable
# because the Mac host GUA is not the Linux VM's source address. On macOS
# use ./scripts/start_rsoxs_stack.sh for CBorg, or Linux Docker with IPv6.
# Optional Linux host-network overlay: compose.hostnet.yaml

services:
  agent:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: agent
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      CBORG_BASE_URL: https://api.cborg.lbl.gov
      CBORG_IP_FAMILY: ipv6
      CBORG_FORCE_IPV6: "1"
      CBORG_IPV6_BIND: ""
      F2W_AGENT_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      F2W_AGENT_PORT: "8090"
      F2W_BACKEND: cborg
      F2W_MODEL: lbl/cborg-chat
      F2W_KG_MODE: json
      F2W_GRAPH: storage/kg/matkg_rsoxs_v1.json,storage/kg/matkg_bl1101_v2.json
      F2W_SCHEMA: storage/schema/rsoxs_schema.yaml
      F2W_WORKDIR: /app/runs/ui_session_rsoxs
      F2W_TRACE_ENABLED: "0"
      F2W_TRACE_DIR: /app/runs/traces
      KG_RAG_BACKEND: cborg
      KG_RAG_CBORG_MODEL: lbl/cborg-chat
      KG_RAG_GRAPH_SOURCE: json
      KG_RAG_GRAPH: storage/kg/matkg_rsoxs_v1.json
      KG_RAG_RETRIEVAL_BACKEND: lexical
      PYSTOW_HOME: /app/.cache/pystow
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8090:8090"
    volumes:
      - ./storage/kg/matkg_rsoxs_v1.json:/app/storage/kg/matkg_rsoxs_v1.json:ro
      - ./storage/kg/matkg_bl1101_v1.json:/app/storage/kg/matkg_bl1101_v1.json:ro
      - ./storage/kg/matkg_bl1101_v2.json:/app/storage/kg/matkg_bl1101_v2.json:ro
      - ./storage/schema/rsoxs_schema.yaml:/app/storage/schema/rsoxs_schema.yaml:ro
      - ./storage/schema/bl1101_schema.yaml:/app/storage/schema/bl1101_schema.yaml:ro
      - agent-runs:/app/runs
      - agent-cache:/app/.cache
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:8090/health"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 45s
      retries: 24
    restart: unless-stopped

frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: frontend
      args:
        # Browser origin, not an in-container hostname. Map host 8090.
        VITE_F2W_AGENT_API_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8090
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${F2W_UI_PORT:-5175}:80"
    depends_on:
      agent:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1/healthz"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      start_period: 10s
      retries: 12
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  agent-runs:
  agent-cache:

tiled:
    image: python:3.11-slim
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
      - ./storage/tiled_config.yml:/app/tiled_config.yml:ro
      - tiled_data:/data
    environment:
      TILED_API_KEY: "${TILED_API_KEY}"
    command: >
      bash -c "pip install 'tiled[server]>=0.2.18' --quiet --no-cache-dir &&
               tiled serve config /app/tiled_config.yml --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8765:8765"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8765/api/v1/"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 15
    networks:
      - f2w

  tiled_seed:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: agent
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      TILED_URI: "http://tiled:8765"
    command:
      - python
      - scripts/ingest_tiled_sim.py
      - "--to-tiled"
      - "--tiled-uri"
      - "http://tiled:8765"
    depends_on:
      tiled:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"
    networks:
